question: A can do a work in 8 days and B in 12 days. They work together for 3 days. What part of the work is left?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(8, 12) = 24 units.

Efficiency of A = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 units/day, and Efficiency of B = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units/day.

Combined efficiency = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day.

Work done in 3 days = 5 × 3 = 15 units.

Remaining work = 24 − 15 = 9 units, which is 9 ÷ 24 = 3/8 of the total work.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 8 days

Time taken by B = 12 days

Time they worked together = 3 days

**Formula / Method Used:**

LCM Method: Total Work = LCM of given days, Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of A and B = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day

⇒ Work done by A and B together in 3 days = 5 × 3 = 15 units

⇒ Remaining work = Total Work − Work Done

⇒ Remaining work = 24 − 15 = 9 units

⇒ Part of the work left = Remaining Work ÷ Total Work

⇒ Part of the work left = 9 ÷ 24 = 3/8

**∴ The correct answer is 3/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

This topic follows the same logic as Time & Work. The only difference is that an emptying pipe has a negative efficiency. Net work in 1 hour for a filling pipe (x hours) and emptying pipe (y hours) = (1 ÷ x) − (1 ÷ y).

Work & Wages

Total wages are always distributed in proportion to the total work completed by each individual. If workers operate for the same number of days, their wages are directly proportional to their efficiencies.

Alternate Days Work

When individuals work consecutively on alternate days, group their efforts by calculating the combined work done in one complete cycle (e.g., 2 days) to easily track total completion time.
